title: Tech Note: List Box for Output form
author: Sara NAKKACH, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The recommendation to replace traditional List-form Output forms with the List Box object remains valid and, if anything, is even more strongly the standard approach in current 4D since List Box (and its View Pro-backed evolution) has become the default choice for tabular record display; this note's step-by-step conversion guidance is still broadly applicable today.
related_updates: 4D View Pro later added a spreadsheet-grid alternative for even richer tabular display needs
List Box gained further collection/entity-selection data source support in later ORDA-era versions
